Package com.google.adk.workflow

package com.google.adk.workflow
  • Related Packages

    Description
    com.google.adk
     
  • Class
    Description
    BaseNode
    Base class for nodes in a workflow graph.
    Edge
    A connection between two nodes in a workflow graph.
    EdgesBuilder
    A builder for the edges of a workflow graph, declared as chains of calls that start at EdgesBuilder.from(com.google.adk.workflow.Node) or EdgesBuilder.fromStart().
    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node, started by EdgesBuilder.from(Node), EdgesBuilder.fromStart() or EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode).
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node group from a fan-out, EdgesBuilder.from(Node, Node, Node...), or EdgesBuilder.from(Collection), which EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode) connects to a JoinNode.
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMap
    A routing map configured in EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.route(java.util.function.Consumer<? super com.google.adk.workflow.EdgesBuilder.RouteMap>) that maps each route the source node may emit to the nodes it leads to, written r.on("billing").then(billing).
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry
    A routing-map entry started by EdgesBuilder.RouteMap.on(java.lang.String) whose routes have no target yet; EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry.then(com.google.adk.workflow.Node, com.google.adk.workflow.Node...) completes it.
    EdgesBuilder.RouteSet
    A set of routes that select a single edge, which fires once when its source emits any of them; separate edges to the same target would fire once each.
    JoinNode
    A node that waits for every predecessor to complete, then outputs their outputs keyed by predecessor name.
    JoinNode.Builder
    Builder for JoinNode.
    Node
    A unit of work in a workflow graph.
    NodeConfig
    A node's retry policy and execution timeout.
    NodeConfig.Builder
    Builder for NodeConfig.
    NodeExecutionState
    The state of one workflow node run, held by the run's Context.
    NodeInfo
    The identity of the workflow-node activation that emitted an Event.
    NodeInfo.Builder
    Builder for NodeInfo.
    NodeRunner
    The runner for one workflow node.
    RetryConfig
    How a node is retried when it fails.
    RetryConfig.Builder
    Builder for RetryConfig.
    Route
    A value on a workflow edge, and the value a node emits to select which of its outgoing edges are followed.
    Route.Default
    The fallback edge, followed when no other routed edge of the node matches what it emitted, including when it emitted no route.
    Route.Flag
    A route identified by a boolean, for a two-way branch.
    Route.Num
    A route identified by an integer.
    Route.Tag
    A route identified by a string, which is the common case.
    Start
    The node that marks where a workflow graph starts.
    Workflow
    A graph of nodes that is itself a node, so a workflow can go wherever a node can, including in another workflow.
    Workflow.Builder
    Builder for Workflow.
    WorkflowConfigurationException
    Thrown when a workflow or one of its nodes is declared in a way that cannot run.
